你, 您 and 你们 all mean 'you'; never use one as a wrong option for another.
她 and 他 sound identical (tā); never pair them in listening.
哪/那 and 哪儿/那儿 differ only by tone; avoid pairing them in listening.
几, 多 and 多少 all gloss as 'how many'.
会 and 能 both mean 'can'.
字 and 汉字 both mean 'character'.
读 and 看 both gloss as 'to read'.
看 'to look; to watch' and 看见 'to see' are too close as options.
在 'to be at; in' and 里 'in; inside' share 'in'.
分 and 分钟 both mean 'minute'.
回 'to return' and 回来 'to come back' mean nearly the same.
爱 'to love; to like' and 喜欢 'to like' overlap.
少 'few; little' and 一点儿 'a little' overlap.
